entities.summary: Salvador Alejandro César Nasralla Salum is a Honduran civil engineer, business administrator, sports journalist, and politician who served as the First Vice President of Honduras from 2022 until his resignation in 2024. A member of the Liberal Party, he has been described as a centrist. He describes himself as center-right.
